I can't see the repository and have no tools, so this comes from my memory of the open-source Netflix Dispatch codebase and may be wrong.

- **Initial page size:** I believe the Cases table opens showing 25 cases per page. The component sets this when it loads, overriding the store's default.
- **Where it's set:** `src/dispatch/static/dispatch/src/case/Table.vue`, which applies the initial table options (page size, sort by reported date, descending) when it is created.
- **Store default:** the Vuex module at `src/dispatch/static/dispatch/src/case/store.js` declares `table.options.itemsPerPage` as 10.

I'm unsure about the 25 and about which file wins, so check `Table.vue` and `store.js` for `itemsPerPage` to confirm.

DEFAULT: 25
FILE: src/dispatch/static/dispatch/src/case/Table.vue
STORE_DEFAULT: 10
